records.omission_quote: In conclusion, using a larger stimuli sample of children, we replicated Maloney and Dal Martello's (2006) finding that kinship and similarity ratings are highly correlated. We found that the effect of sex was the same on similarity and on kinship judgments, contrary to DeBruine et al (2009). However, we found that the effect of age was different on similarity judgments than on kinship judgments, contrary to Maloney and Dal Martello (2006).
